rot.keySquares.ideia.ex0.e1: Every square has a name: the letter of its file and the number of its rank. Your king is on d4; your pawn, on d2.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex0.e2: The king moves one square in any direction. The kings are never on neighbouring squares: e3, e4 and e5 are off limits to both.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex0.e3: The pawn only moves forward, one square at a time; on its first move it may go two. When it reaches d8, it becomes a queen.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex0.e4: This is called promoting, and d8 is the promotion square. With an extra queen, White wins.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex0.certo: Exactly! Your king moved one square, from d4 to d5.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex0.alt.rei: That works too: the king moved one square. The question, though, asked for d5.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex0.alt.volta: Let's go back and play the move we asked for.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex0.alt.peao: The pawn moved one square, towards d8. That works too, but the question asked for the king.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex0.l1: Now the black king also moves one square. It cannot go to e4 or e5, which neighbour your king.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex0.revela: The king moves one square: from d4 to d5.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex0.livre.volta: Let's go back to the starting position. Take the king to d5 or tap {verResposta}
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex0.p: Move your king from d4 to d5, or tap {verResposta}
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.e1: In this ending, White tries to promote the pawn on e8. Black tries to stop it; for Black, a draw is enough.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.e2: If the pawn runs alone, the black king steps in front of it and holds the draw. The pawn needs its king.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.e3: If the white king reaches certain squares, the pawn promotes, whatever the defence. These are the key squares.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.e4: With the pawn on e3, the key squares are d5, e5 and f5: two ranks ahead of it, on the e-file and the files beside it.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.e3e4.1: With this move, Black finds a resource that holds the draw.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.e3e4.2: The black king goes to e6, in front of the pawn. With the pawn on e4, the key squares have moved up to d6, e6 and f6.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.f4e4.1: With this move, Black finds a resource that holds the draw.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.f4e4.2: The black king goes to e6: d5, e5 and f5 now neighbour it, and your king cannot step in.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.f4f3.1: With this move, Black finds a resource that holds the draw.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.f4f3.2: The black king takes e5, in the middle of the key squares, and shuts d5 and f5 to your king.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.f4g3.1: With this move, Black finds a resource that holds the draw.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.f4g3.2: The black king takes e5, in the middle of the key squares, and shuts d5 and f5 to your king.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.f4g4.1: With this move, Black finds a resource that holds the draw.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.f4g4.2: The black king takes e5, in the middle of the key squares, and shuts d5 and f5 to your king.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.f4g5.1: With this move, Black finds a resource that holds the draw.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.err.f4g5.2: The black king takes e5, in the middle of the key squares, and shuts d5 and f5 to your king.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.certo: Exactly! Your king has reached f5, a key square.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.l1: With the king on a key square, promotion is guaranteed, whatever the defence.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.l2: The black king goes to e7, in front of the pawn.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.l3: Your king goes to e5, in front of the pawn. The black king must move and cannot step up to d6, e6 or f6.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.l4: The black king goes to f7, and your king climbs to d6, clearing the way for the pawn.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.l5: Your king carries on to f7. Now the black king cannot reach e8, the promotion square.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.l6: Only now does the pawn advance, with the road clear, all the way to e8.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.l7: What if, in this position, White pushed the pawn instead of the king?
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.l8: With the pawn on e4, the key squares move up to d6, e6 and f6.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.l9: The black king goes to f7 and watches e6 and f6. It is the only move that holds the draw.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.l10: If your king goes to e5, the black king returns to e7, and d6, e6 and f6 stay shut.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.l11: The pawn advanced too early: the key squares moved up, and the white king was left below them.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.l12: That is why the king goes in front first; the pawn advances afterwards.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.revela: The best is to take the king to f5, a key square.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.livre.fala: Keep playing with White and see how Black defends.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.fins.capturado: The black king captured the pawn: it is a draw.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.fins.afogado: The black king has no move and is not attacked: it is a draw.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.fins.repeticao: The black king always shut the way to the key squares.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.livre.volta: Let's go back to the starting position. Suggest another move or tap {verResposta}
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex1.p: White to move. Think and suggest a move, or tap {verResposta}
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.e1: Now let's think from Black's side. The pawn is on d3, and the key squares are c5, d5 and e5.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.e2: The white king on f4 already touches e5. Your king must stop it from entering a key square.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.d7c6.1: With this move, White finds a way to win.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.d7c6.2: The white king steps into e5, a key square, and the pawn will promote.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.d7c7.1: With this move, White finds a way to win.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.d7c7.2: The white king steps into e5, a key square, and the pawn will promote.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.d7c8.1: With this move, White finds a way to win.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.d7c8.2: The white king steps into e5, a key square, and the pawn will promote.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.d7d8.1: With this move, White finds a way to win.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.d7d8.2: The white king steps into e5, a key square, and the pawn will promote.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.d7e7.1: With this move, White finds a way to win.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.d7e7.2: The white king steps into e5, a key square, and the pawn will promote.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.d7e8.1: With this move, White finds a way to win.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.d7e8.2: The white king steps into e5, a key square, and the pawn will promote.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.d7e6.1: With this move, White finds a way to win.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.err.d7e6.2: The white king goes to e4, facing yours. Since Black must move, the black king will end up giving up a key square.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.l1: On d6, the black king watches all three key squares.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.l2: The white king goes to e4.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.l3: The black king goes to e6, facing it. It was the only move: anywhere else, the white king would reach d5 or e5.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.l4: The pawn advances to d4, and the key squares move up to c6, d6 and e6.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.l5: The black king returns to d6, in front of the pawn, in the middle of the new key squares.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.l6: The white king cannot reach any key square: Black holds the draw.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.certo: Exactly! On d6, your king watches c5, d5 and e5.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.revela: The best is to take the king to d6, from where it watches c5, d5 and e5.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.livre.fala: Keep playing with Black and see how White attacks.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.fins.afogado: The black king has no move and is not attacked: it is a draw.
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.livre.volta: Let's go back to the starting position. Suggest another move or tap {verResposta}
rot.keySquares.ideia.ex2.p: Black to move. Think and suggest a move, or tap {verResposta}
rot.keySquares.demos.regra.1: A rule for finding the key squares: with the pawn on the 2nd, 3rd or 4th rank, they lie two ranks ahead of it.
rot.keySquares.demos.regra.2: Here the pawn is on c2: the key squares are c4 and its neighbours b4 and d4. The rule holds for pawns on the b- to g-files.
rot.keySquares.demos.regra.3: The white king goes to d4, a key square: the win is guaranteed.
rot.keySquares.demos.regra.4: The black king goes to c6, and the white king settles on c4, in front of the pawn.
rot.keySquares.demos.regra.5: The white king keeps climbing, always in front of the pawn.
rot.keySquares.demos.regra.6: With the white king on d7, the black king can no longer reach c8, the promotion square.
rot.keySquares.demos.regra.7: Only then does the pawn advance to promote.
rot.keySquares.demos.cedo.1: White has pushed the pawn to g4 before the king. Now let's think from Black's side.
rot.keySquares.demos.cedo.2: With the pawn on g4, the key squares move up to f6, g6 and h6, close to the black king.
rot.keySquares.demos.cedo.3: The black king takes f6, one of the key squares.
rot.keySquares.demos.cedo.4: The white king comes to e3; the black king goes to g5 and attacks the pawn.
rot.keySquares.demos.cedo.5: The white king defends the pawn, but it is below it, far from f6, g6 and h6.
rot.keySquares.demos.cedo.6: The pawn advanced too early, and Black holds the draw.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.d3c2.1: With 1.Kc2?, the king moves away from the key squares e4, f4 and g4.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.d3c2.2: After 1...Ke5!, the black king gets there first and shuts e4 and f4.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.d3c3.1: With 1.Kc3?, the king moves away from the key squares e4, f4 and g4.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.d3c3.2: After 1...Ke5!, the black king gets there first and shuts e4 and f4.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.d3c4.1: With 1.Kc4?, the king moves away from the key squares e4, f4 and g4.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.d3c4.2: After 1...Ke5!, the black king gets there first and shuts e4 and f4.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.d3d2.1: With 1.Kd2?, the king retreats instead of heading for the key squares.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.d3d2.2: After 1...Kf5!, the black king watches all three key squares: e4, f4 and g4.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.d3d4.1: With 1.Kd4?, the king stands beside the key squares but enters none of them.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.d3d4.2: After 1...Kf5!, the black king watches e4, f4 and g4, and your king cannot get in.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.d3e2.1: With 1.Ke2?, the king does not get closer to the key squares.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.d3e2.2: After 1...Ke6!, the black king is one step from f5 and reaches the key squares first.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.d3e3.1: With 1.Ke3?, the king stays below the key squares instead of stepping into e4.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.d3e3.2: After 1...Ke5!, the black king takes the front and shuts e4 and f4 to your king.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.f2f3.1: With 1.f3?, the pawn advances before the king, and the key squares move up to e5, f5 and g5.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.f2f3.2: After 1...Kf5!, the black king takes f5, right in front of the pawn.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.f2f4.1: With 1.f4?, the pawn advances two squares before the king, and the key squares move up to e6, f6 and g6.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.err.f2f4.2: After 1...Kf5!, the black king blocks the pawn, and your king cannot reach e6, f6 or g6.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.enunciado: Play as White and find the best move.
rot.keySquares.pratica.ataque.fim: Your king went in front, reached a key square, and the pawn only advanced afterwards.
rot.keySquares.pratica.defesa.err.c8b7.1: With 1...Kb7?, the king leaves the front of the pawn and stops watching d6.
rot.keySquares.pratica.defesa.err.c8b7.2: After 2.Kd6!, the white king steps into a key square, and the pawn will promote.
rot.keySquares.pratica.defesa.err.c8b8.1: With 1...Kb8?, the king moves away from d6.
rot.keySquares.pratica.defesa.err.c8b8.2: After 2.Kd6!, the white king steps into a key square, and the pawn will promote.
rot.keySquares.pratica.defesa.err.c8d8.1: With 1...Kd8?, the king moves away from b6.
rot.keySquares.pratica.defesa.err.c8d8.2: After 2.Kd6!, the white king steps into a key square, and the pawn will promote.
rot.keySquares.pratica.defesa.err.c8d7.1: With 1...Kd7?, the king leaves the pawn's file.
rot.keySquares.pratica.defesa.err.c8d7.2: After 2.Kd5!, the white king faces yours, and Black, to move, cannot hold b6, c6 and d6.
rot.keySquares.pratica.defesa.enunciado: Play as Black and find the best move.
rot.keySquares.pratica.defesa.fim: Your king stayed in front of the pawn and watched the key squares to the end.
